$comment: Temptation and the street (D-068): the Underpass after dark, a dropped wallet, a stray dog. Nothing here is a crime the World records; crimes are the crime system's (D-069).

events.title: The sample tray
events.prompt: The sample lady has turned to restock. The tray of cheese cubes is right there. All of them.

outcomes.text: One cube. Delicious. Civilised.
You palm six cubes and walk on, chewing casually. Nobody saw. You think.
The sample lady turns back just as your hand closes on the sixth cube. "Hungry?" she says.

events.title: One more round
events.prompt: It's late. You have work tomorrow. {name} is already waving at the bartender. "One more?"

outcomes.text: One more becomes a story you'll both tell for years, with details that don't quite match.
You buy the round. You are, for one shining minute, the best person in the bar.

memory.text: Bought the round for {name} and everyone.

outcomes.text: You hug {name} goodbye and head home. Tomorrow-you sends a thank-you note.

events.title: Just looking
events.prompt: The shop assistant says the thing: "Honestly? That colour was made for you." Your bank balance looks away.

choices.label: Walk out before it's too late

outcomes.text: You leave with nothing but your dignity and a lingering sense that it really was your colour.
You try it on, take a mirror selfie, and put it back. Window shopping is free, and so are compliments.

events.title: Brand new, still in the box
events.prompt: Under the overpass, a man in a good coat opens a box: a "brand-new" Lyra Pro. "Sixty, cash. Tonight only."

outcomes.text: Back under a streetlight, you open the box. It's a brick wrapped in a sock. A nice sock, at least.

memory.text: Paid $60 for a brick in a phone box at the Underpass.

outcomes.text: It's a real phone, warm, with someone else's lock screen. You feel sick and drop it in a police donation box on the way home.

memory.text: Bought a stolen phone at the Underpass and gave it up.

outcomes.text: He laughs, spits, and is gone into the dark. You still have your money and your story.
"Fine." Twenty dollars buys you a beautiful box and nothing in it.

memory.text: Bought an empty phone box for $20 at the Underpass.

outcomes.text: "Too good to be true," you say, mostly to yourself, and keep walking.

events.title: Footsteps
events.prompt: The footsteps behind you have matched yours for two blocks. You speed up. So do they.

outcomes.text: You spin round. A man with a takeaway bag freezes. "I live on this street," he says, terrified of you.

memory.text: Confronted a man following me. He lived on my street.

outcomes.text: You spin round. The figure hesitates, then turns down an alley. Your heart takes a while to slow.

memory.text: Faced down someone following me at night.

outcomes.text: You cross, under the streetlights. The footsteps don't follow. You walk the rest of the way very fast.
You call nobody and have a loud conversation about how your brother the boxer is meeting you round the corner. It works.

events.title: A shadow with a tail
events.prompt: A scruffy dog with one ear up has been trotting beside you for a block, as though you've known each other for years.

outcomes.text: The sausage roll vanishes in one movement. The dog looks at you like you invented food.

memory.text: Fed a stray dog a sausage roll.

outcomes.text: You walk it to the shelter. The volunteer knows it: "Biscuit! Again!" Biscuit wags at you as the door closes.

memory.text: Walked a stray called Biscuit back to the shelter.

outcomes.text: "Go home, buddy." It sits and watches you leave. Ouch.

events.title: Room for one more
events.prompt: It's pouring. {name} is huddled in a doorway with a newspaper on their head. You have an umbrella.

outcomes.text: You hold it over both of you and walk {name} to the bus stop. You get one wet shoulder and a warm feeling.

memory.text: Shared my umbrella with {name} in the rain.

outcomes.text: You hand it over and run. You arrive soaked and smug. {name} will tell this story at dinner.

memory.text: Gave {name} my umbrella and ran home in the rain.

outcomes.text: You hurry past. The rain gets heavier, which feels like a comment.

events.title: Paint under the overpass
events.prompt: A crew is painting a huge mural on the Underpass wall by torchlight. One of them holds out a spray can. "You want to add something?"

choices.label: Add a small flower in the corner

outcomes.text: Your flower is wobbly and perfect. The crew cheers. It'll be there for years, probably.

memory.text: Painted a flower on the Underpass mural.

outcomes.text: You watch the wall turn into a river, a bridge, a sunrise. Better than anything in a gallery.
"Isn't this illegal?" The crew looks at you, then at each other, and keeps painting.

events.title: Quick hands
events.prompt: In the crowd, you see a kid's hand slide into a woman's open bag and come out with a purse. The kid sees you see.

outcomes.text: "Hey! Your bag!" The kid drops the purse and bolts. The woman thanks you three times.
You shout, but the crowd swallows the kid whole. The woman is left holding an empty bag and your sympathy.
You say nothing. The kid melts away. You think about it on and off all day.
